scenarios.title: Your own phone
scenarios.says: A spam that gets through is a mild annoyance. A real message sent to the spam folder is a missed dentist appointment.

scenarios.title: A bank's fraud alerts
scenarios.says: Missing a fraudulent message costs real money. Flagging a genuine one costs a customer five minutes.

scenarios.title: A company's shared inbox
scenarios.says: Both cost about the same: somebody deals with it either way.

scenarios.title: A hospital paging system
scenarios.says: A blocked message can be a life. A spam getting through wastes a few seconds.
